title: FinalProofRequest
description: What proof is asked to judge after the rounds, as proof@1's prove takes it: the slice whole, its base, the last head, what the builder declared with the test files, and the bugs to plant, and the design's worked examples to try.

examples.description: The design's worked examples of the slice's actions, as the slice's request carries them; each is tried on the head in a throwaway copy of its own. Left out or empty, none is.
